role: CI guard (make strict-concurrency-enabled; ci.yml strict-concurrency job, gates.yml) that project.pbxproj sets SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY=complete and SWIFT_VERSION=6.0 in every build configuration and SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=YES in at least one.
toplevel: cd to repo root; fail if pbxproj missing. Counts lines with grep -c: configs = 'SWIFT_VERSION = ' (8 at 8d32097), strict = 'SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY = <level>;' (8), werror = 'SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS = YES;' (2), swift6 = 'SWIFT_VERSION = <ver>;' (8). Prints the three ratios. fail (exit 1) if strict < configs, if swift6 < configs, or if werror < 1; else prints clean. Counts are line counts, not per-configuration matches: a configuration with two strict lines and another with none would still pass, and a configuration lacking SWIFT_VERSION is not in the denominator. Warnings-as-errors only needs to be on in one configuration (2 of 8 at HEAD).

units.does: Prints 'ERROR: <message>' to stderr and exits the script with status 1.
